SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION UPDATES 
Date & Time: September 20, 2026 (Sunday) as of 10:31 AM
Yari ang mga ongoing maintenance activities subong sa bahin sang:
6:00AM to 6:00PM
Portion of MF2 - San Lorenzo Ruiz, Prk. Canaan, Santorini, Purok Yanson, Tierra Minerva, Eroreco subd, Prk Casiana, Prk Sulom 1,St.  Scholastica Academy, La Salle Avenue (La Salle to St. Scho), Capitol  Ville, Portion of USLS.
Portion of BF5 - CL Montelibano-6th St. Going Lasalle.
Reason:
● Reconductoring of 1.0 km 2/0 bare wire 3Ph Primary line MF2 along La Salle; and
● Reconductoring of 0.3km #2 bare wire 3-phase prim. Line BF5 along CL Montelibano.
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mas madugay nga power interruptions kag mapabakod ang aton distribution system.
Madamo gid nga salamat. 
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService
